basis: Assignment decisions recorded here. The classification worksheet was removed. Coverage provenance remains in records/api-coverage.json.
scope: Responsibilities remain mandatory. Only stage assignments and supporting rationale change; expected support, disposition, implementation and verification statuses remain unchanged.
primaryDecisions: Keep renderer loaded/isStyleLoaded operations in S04 because readiness is part of lifecycle acceptance.
Keep all 43 proposed wrapper-internal entries pending S04 until public export/ref reachability is audited; do not turn them into internal dispositions on naming alone.
Reuse existing child stages for raster-array, global state, featuresets, iconsets, models and indoor responsibilities. Retain every previously required child stage.
Put renderer diagnostic overlays under S48a with a dedicated child, because the specification has no S48e stage.
Native tintColor remains S04 investigation: Android wrapper setter is a no-op; wrapper absence alone does not establish SDK unsupported status.
MapView.props.localizeLabels remains its existing S48d.label-localization assignment until per-map ownership and reset semantics are resolved with the S04 configuration contract.
